consentModal.title: How We Use Cookies
consentModal.description: This website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to ensure proper functionality, analyze user behavior, and with your consent deliver personalized content and advertisements. You can adjust your preferences at any time via "Manage Cookie Preferences" or select "Reject All" to keep only essential cookies required for the website to operate. For more details please refer to our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
sections.description: These cookies are essential for the core functionality of the website, including maintaining your session, storing login status, and remembering your cookie consent preferences. This category cannot be disabled, and no personally identifiable information is stored.

sections.title: Functional Cookies
sections.description: These cookies allow the website to remember your personal preferences, such as language selection, regional settings, and interface layout, in order to provide a more consistent and personalized experience. Disabling this category does not affect core website functionality, but some features may not work as intended.

sections.title: Analytics Cookies
sections.description: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the website, including pages visited, time spent, and traffic sources. All data collected is processed in aggregated, anonymized form and is used solely to continuously improve website performance and user experience.

sections.title: Advertising Cookies
sections.description: These cookies are set by this website and advertising partners to build an interest profile based on your browsing behavior, and to deliver personalized advertising content on this website and other platforms. If you disable this category, you will still see advertisements, but they will no longer be personalized to your interests.
